credits.title: Streets of Glória
credits.overview: Gabriel, a 24-year-old anthropologist from a wealthy family from the interior of the Northeast, is gay and in the closet. Following the death of his grandmother, he decides to go to Rio de Janeiro to study the lives of sex workers. Seduced by his object of study, Gabriel will become one of them.

credits.title: D.P.A. 4: O Fantástico Reino de Ondion
credits.overview: Mel and Zeca face a dangerous mission to find Max, who has mysteriously disappeared. In search of their friend, they end up in the kingdom of Ondion, a colorful magical world, where they will have to face the villains Rumorum and Juks.

credits.title: Vitória
credits.overview: Nina is an elderly woman who lives alone and feels distressed by the increasing violence in her neighborhood. Amidst conflicts with her neighbors, she decides to film the movement of drug traffickers from her window, hoping to assist the police. credits.title: Meu Nome é Gal
credits.overview: Film about the Bahian singer dives into the moment when shy Gracinha becomes Gal Costa, during the violent, innovative and mind-blowing years that helped shape Brazil's greatest singer.

credits.title: Burn
credits.overview: A young man’s final visit with his boyfriend to his now-empty childhood home before its scheduled demolition resurfaces his emotional connection to the house and to a childhood friend.

credits.title: All the Awards I Never Gave You
credits.overview: An unexpected encounter between two young actors on the rise, in the bathroom of an award venue, brings up unresolved feelings and a love story that has possibly not come to an end yet.

credits.title: After That Party
credits.overview: Leo had never imagined he would see his dad kissing another man in the middle of a party - until it happened. Now, with the help of his best friend Carol, he has to find a way to tell his dad that he found out about his secret.
